item.name: Create a Job using a Worksheet

request.name: Create a Job using a Worksheet

description.content:
Jobs are complex entities that have many dependent entities. That causes an issue to arrise when there is an error creating a dependent entity, causing your Job to be invalid and requiring you to go through and delete each item you already created.
The Job Worksheet allows you to create a Job with its primary dependent entities in one request that will rollback all of the newly created entities automatically as one transaction if the request fails.
